steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continued learning, volunteer work, or professional contribution. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your PMP active and demonstrate your ongoing commitment to project-management excellence.
